'''Shamuillan''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the war, a [[Separatist War|civil war]] had broken out between the Republic-backed [[Ord Mantell Central Authority]] and the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]]. Shamuillan worked inside the Republic's [[Fort Garnik]] on [[Avilatan]] island, where he operated a stall from which he sold equipment. While at his stall Shamuillan wore [[Color/Legends|grey]] [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]]. He had green skin, no hair, blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and a large scar running across his face.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shamuillan first appeared in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released by [[BioWare]]. In the game, Shamuillan acts as a Republic social items vendor on Ord Mantell.<ref name="TOR" />
